breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the original error by listing 'Slope vanishes at both supports' as a boundary condition. The ground truth removes this incorrect statement entirely. For a simply supported beam under a midspan point load, the slope at the supports is non-zero (and is in fact one of the quantities to be computed). The zero-slope condition applies at midspan, not at the supports. The generated spec even lists both 'slope vanishes at both supports' AND 'slope vanishes at midspan,' compounding the error.
